purpose: Predeclared sanity checks, scale diagnostics and negative controls; not labeled training data or a representative accuracy benchmark.
selection_policy: Controls were chosen from primary references before inspecting the completed environmental release. Parameters must not be tuned solely to make these sites pass.

sites.name: Yungay, Atacama Desert — approximate regional center
sites.coordinate_precision: Approximate center as tabulated; not a surveyed field-station position or exact study footprint.

evidence.title: Analogue Sites for Mars Missions: MSL and Beyond, LPI Contribution 1612 (2011), Yungay contribution
evidence.supports: Identifies Yungay as an arid Mars-analog study area, gives the approximate 24 S / 69.9 W center and a 10 km by 10 km extent, and reports negligible vegetation. These are historical site descriptions.

evidence.title: Dal Bo et al. (2021), GPR and EMI Characterization of the Hyperarid Study Site of Yungay, Chile
evidence.supports: Independent geophysical study of Yungay's value for Mars-oriented subsurface investigations; does not establish that its regional terrain must rank highest for Jezero.

sites.test_purpose: Check whether a documented hyperarid, sparsely vegetated region survives the Earth environment screen.
sites.limits: Not a target-specific ground-truth match. Regional-coordinate uncertainty and cell boundaries must be examined. No contemporary access claim.

sites.name: Manaus ZF2 K34, AmeriFlux BR-Ma2
sites.coordinate_precision: Published site coordinate; containing cell is much larger than the flux-tower footprint.

evidence.title: AmeriFlux site registry, BR-Ma2 Manaus — ZF2 K34
evidence.supports: Lists the site at -2.6091, -60.2093, with evergreen broadleaf forest and tropical rainforest climate classifications. Registry accessed 2026-11-06.

sites.test_purpose: A wet forest may resemble a planetary cell's coarse terrain but should fail the declared dry/barren field-exercise screen.
sites.limits: This is a negative control for one task profile, not a claim that forests are useless for every planetary process study. Site-specific details page returned HTTP 403; only the accessible registry is used.

sites.name: Cinder Lake RATS test-site coordinate
sites.coordinate_precision: Converted from the NASA guide's N35°19′21″, W111°31′05″; not a boundary of the Apollo crater fields.

evidence.title: NASA Desert RATS participation guide, Revision A (2006)
evidence.supports: Provides a field-test coordinate and describes basaltic cinders and flat-to-hummocky terrain. The description is historical and does not establish current access or condition.

evidence.title: NASA, Arizona's Lunar Craters (2019)
evidence.supports: Documents the Cinder Lake crater fields' Apollo-training use and their erosion in subsequent imagery.

sites.test_purpose: Determine whether a useful local lunar training environment is diluted in a roughly 14 km regional cell. Failure of a region-wide barren threshold would not invalidate the documented local analog.
sites.limits: Not a valid positive label for every region-wide dry/barren filter; basaltic-material similarity is a different dimension from current default terrain scoring.

sites.name: Garwood Valley, Antarctica — approximate site center
sites.coordinate_precision: Published regional center; not a verified local field footprint.

evidence.title: Analogue Sites for Mars Missions: MSL and Beyond, Garwood Valley contribution
evidence.supports: Describes a cold-region analog relevant to frozen fluvial/lacustrine systems and gives the -78.03, 164.14 site center.

sites.test_purpose: Ensure missing southern-polar environmental data leads to an insufficient-evidence explanation, not a statement that the region is physically unsuitable.
sites.limits: Missing land-cover/vegetation coverage must not become zero vegetation, a false barren classification, or a fabricated high-confidence match.
